summary: The Art of Dentistry has 250 Google reviews at a 4.9 average and a clear phone number. The main appointment buttons do not work, and leftover interface text makes a Yorkville clinic look unfinished.

findings.problem: Several Request Appointment buttons link to #, so they do not go anywhere. No booking form is visible on the page, and there is no chat or WhatsApp.
findings.cost: A patient who clicks Request Appointment and sees nothing happen is a lost booking, and you never learn they tried.
findings.fix: Every appointment button linked to one working form with a confirmation message.

findings.problem: Leftover interface text shows on the page: Accessible Version Standard Version, Open Menu Close Menu, Search Search and a stray The Art of Dentistry line.
findings.cost: System text on a Yorkville clinic's homepage makes the clinic look unfinished before a patient reads anything.
findings.fix: A clean page with accessibility tools built in properly and hidden from the main text.

findings.problem: No before and after images appear on the page, even though cosmetic services are the main draw. The 250 Google reviews line is not linked to your Google listing.
findings.cost: Cosmetic patients want to see results and check reviews. Without a link they cannot verify your 4.9.
findings.fix: Captioned before and after cases and a link from your rating to the full reviews.

findings.problem: The hero headline starts with a lowercase toronto's, and the hours say closed Saturdays but open 1 Saturday per month with no dates. Dr. Weiss is named in a review but not on your team page.
findings.cost: Unclear hours cost visits and bad reviews, and typos in the headline weaken first impressions.
findings.fix: A proofread build, clear Saturday dates and a team page that matches your reviews.

redesign: A booking first homepage with working buttons, a short form and your 4.9 rating linked to Google.
Captioned results and named reviews beside every booking button.
Treatment pages written to rank for searches like Invisalign Yorkville and cosmetic dentist Toronto.
